title: Ariel Moore on Faith, Recovery, and the Freedom to Be Known
summary: Ariel Moore, author of Divine Authenticity, joins Jed Chappell to reflect on addiction, motherhood, faith, and rebuilding a life. She describes the practical support that gave her room to change, the spiritual life she developed, and the freedom of bringing her whole story into the open. Together, they consider how relationships, opportunity, and a safe place to belong can change what someone sees as possible.
